name: ApprovalFlowSankey
tagline: Approval Flow Sankey shows how approval requests really move between stages.
description: Approval Flow Sankey shows how approval requests really move between stages. Every request leaves a trail of moves – Submitted to Line manager, Line manager to Finance review, Finance review to CFO approval, and finally Approved, Rejected or Withdrawn. The control draws these moves as a Sankey diagram: each stage is a bar, and the ribbons between them are as wide as the number of requests (or the amount) that took that path.
features: A Sankey flow diagram with ribbons sized by request count or amount
A phone-friendly stage ladder and an accessible flow table
Highlights rework loops (sent back to an earlier stage)
Approval / rejection rates and the bottleneck stage
Drill into a flow or stage to list its requests
Open a record or copy the list
